criteria.text: The ignore rules match the project's real stack (Python caches, build output, virtual environments) and add nothing for stacks the project does not use.
Secrets and local environment files (.env and similar) are ignored.
Common operating system and editor clutter (such as .DS_Store, swap files, editor settings folders) is ignored.
The file is grouped and readable, and the change is committed on its own with no other file touched.
